display_long_description:
Pets IO brings you into a lively VR world where strategy meets cuteness and chaos! Collect and hatch unique pets, each with their own powers, and lead them into competitive battles against players from around the world. Whether you're growing your squad, unlocking powerful upgrades, or chasing leaderboard glory, every second is packed with action.

Use motion-based controls to move, dodge, and outsmart your opponents while commanding your pets to attack, defend, and swarm. Explore a vibrant, dynamic world full of surprises, and experience a fresh take on the io genre—now in virtual reality!

Get ready to collect, compete, and conquer in Pets IO, where your pets are more than cute—they’re your army!
